question: What claim about transmission is at stake in stating that the teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover?
premises: The teaching concerns the earth-moving good-eaters.
It was told by an earth-mover.
The address is to the beloved.
inference: The teaching of the earth-moving good-eaters was transmitted by an earth-mover to the beloved.
uncertainties: The specific teaching content is not given in this verse.
plain_english: The teaching of the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover, O beloved.
